MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The MX Master 3 feels like a useful upgrade because I have repeatedly chosen mice with comfort and convenience features; ergonomics and customizable controls give me a concrete reason to replace an older mouse.",
    "The Blink bundle connects my ongoing use of Alexa devices with my earlier interest in home security, offering a new use for an ecosystem I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The compact keyboard, Roku stick, and larger Echo Show overlap with needs my recent full-size keyboard, Fire TV bundle, and Echo Show 5 already cover. Related products are not necessarily useful next purchases.",
    "The gaming SSD and NVMe enclosure require needs or hardware I have not shown. Buying an external hard drive does not mean I want to install internal storage or assemble a portable drive.",
    "Mac-compatible accessories do not mean I need a new computer, and the wired earbuds do not address any current need I recognize."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Alexa and streaming devices seems to be treated as a reason to buy more devices with overlapping functions, even after recent purchases.",
    "My computer accessory and storage purchases seem to be stretched into interest in almost any computer hardware, without enough attention to its specific purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent keyboard choice included a numeric keypad and full-size layout, which makes a compact keyboard less appealing despite its compatibility.",
    "I distinguish a worthwhile upgrade to an older device from a replacement for something I just bought; the age and purpose of my existing equipment matter.",
    "Accessories need to fit equipment I actually own. I would need to confirm USB connector direction and available ports, and an NVMe enclosure needs a drive I do not currently have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in practical computer accessories and Alexa devices, but miss whether each item adds a needed capability or duplicates a recent purchase."
}
